Sadly, pretrial detainees are currently being denied Medicaid coverage. 

The Due Process #ContinuityofCare Act works to reform a major flaw in our Medicaid system. 

We must pass this critical legislation so we can end the dangerous cycle of treatment interruption & recidivism. https://t.co/D1pu7hTCiH

Happy Doctor's Day to all healthcare workers who work tirelessly to ensure the health of others. Today, we honor the incredible contributions that physicians and healthcare workers have given back to the Dayton community.

With drug overdose as the leading cause of death in Americans under 50, passage of the MAT Act is critical and will greatly improve substance abuse treatment across the U.S.

https://t.co/Clase4dE5l

🚨ICYMI: 40% of the country does not have access to effective substance abuse treatment. The MAT Act, which passed the House last week, will help centers like OneFifteen treat opioid addictions in a timely manner. 

https://t.co/3hpebgcgW5

Buprenorphine provides an opportunity for those struggling with substance abuse to get back on their feet & restore their life. Allowing doctors to prescribe this medication without waiting on a waiver is critical to beginning treatment & saving lives.

https://t.co/kge2F6gHpt

Today is International Overdose Awareness Day. 

My Mainstreaming Addiction Treatment Act, which works to improve opioid addiction treatment and cut through bureaucratic red tape, passed the House earlier this year. Read more here: https://t.co/Clase4d6fN

The @thefoodbankinc is a pillar of the Dayton community. I am pursuing $2 million in funding for their expansion which would eliminate barriers to healthcare and create jobs all while keeping members of our community fed. https://t.co/7tQGG7YmhJ

If passed through Congress, the $2 million in funding I am working to secure for the @thefoodbankinc would assist in their healthcare expansion and allow them to continue providing for members of the Miami Valley community. 

Learn more here:

https://t.co/lzKHnmrpfc

ICYMI: The Dayton Foodbank's $2 million expansion would eliminate barriers to healthcare and create jobs, all while keeping members of the community fed. 

Read more here on why I am pursuing this funding for @thefoodbankinc :

https://t.co/UCqJ8bzTQo

Local parks serve our communities by providing residents a safe outdoor space to gather, play, exercise, and relax. I am proud to again lead the bipartisan bill to protect & enhance opportunities for families to enjoy the great recreational spaces the Dayton region has to offer.

(1/2) Today, I partnered with health care experts from St. Mary Development Corporation, Community Health Centers of Greater Dayton, @CareSource, and the @DaytonVA Medical Center to help Ohioans better understand their VA, Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid benefits. https://t.co/1ZWiHVHRvv

(2/2) Let me be clear: I oppose cutting VA, Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid benefits for current and near-term beneficiaries. 
 
I will fight to protect these programs for our seniors and veterans. https://t.co/jMc1AVf8U8

(2/2) Our bill allows incarcerated individuals to receive Medicaid benefits 30 days before being released.

The Reentry Act will save lives by helping communities in #Ohio and across the country combat the #opioid epidemic.

Click here to learn more:
https://t.co/4v8PizsJYE

(1/2) During this time of record inflation, we must ensure that retirees can access affordable health care.

I am proud to partner with @RepGolden, @RepTenney, and @RepDanKildee to introduce bipartisan legislation that would reauthorize the Health Coverage Tax Credit.

(2/2) Providing a long-term reauthorization of the Health Coverage Tax Credit would give over tens of thousands of salaried retirees, including the Delphi Salaried Retirees, peace of mind.

Learn more about our efforts here: https://t.co/lFGyid8a1g

(2/2) Our bill amends a portion of the Medicaid Inmate Exclusion Policy that perpetuates a dangerous cycle of treatment interruption and recidivism for individuals awaiting trial.

Learn more about our efforts to fix this flaw in our Medicaid system:

https://t.co/xAQ3Lz0MNK

The opioid epidemic has negatively affected too many families across Ohio.

Earlier today, @MCOhioSheriff Rob Streck, Clark County Sheriff Deb Burchett, and I spoke about the need to make treatment services available to pretrial inmates. https://t.co/v2XFDVyDkW

Local leaders support the Due Process Continuity of Care Act because they understand the dangers of treatment interruption.

Learn more about the bipartisan legislation that I introduced with @RepDavidTrone, @RepRutherfordFL, and @RepPaulTonko:
https://t.co/Ss8aEyVW6i

It is vital for Ohioans who are receiving opioid addiction treatment to have continuity of care.

My bipartisan bill w/ @RepDavidTrone, @RepRutherfordFL, & @RepPaulTonko makes treatment services available to pretrial inmates.

More from @DaytonDailyNews: https://t.co/pk6j0PJvA9 https://t.co/71Is0QhmAg

The Medicaid Inmate Exclusion Policy has an unconstitutional flaw that perpetuates recidivism.

I held a press conference w/ @MCOhioSheriff Streck & Clark County Sheriff Burchett about my bipartisan legislation to end this dangerous cycle.

More from @WHIOTV’s @RobertsonT222 ⬇️ https://t.co/yBBSL5qLrx

Today, I toured the @FiveRiversHC’s Edgemont Campus and held a press conference to highlight the centers receiving $2.3M in federal funding.

This funding will allow the Five Rivers Health Center to expand its reach and provide accessible and affordable healthcare to West Dayton. https://t.co/rugZus0UFl

Five Rivers Health Centers provide crucial services in Southwest Ohio and have a tremendous impact on our community.

I supported @FiveRiversHC's efforts to secure $2.3 million in federal funding and key tax credits.

Read more from @DaytonDailyNews:
https://t.co/eea8scNvnJ https://t.co/tmSboTl56E

(2/2) We received briefings from senior VA leadership and toured multiple facilities, such as the Medical Center, St. Mary’s Veterans housing properties, and the Dayton National Cemetery.

Learn more:
https://t.co/Usi8sKY3cC

Our veterans sacrifice so much to protect our freedoms. Once they return home, we need to help them access the services they are entitled to.

My office is happy to assist you in obtaining your healthcare benefits or records.

More below:
https://t.co/oZ9CUwQxsn

(1/2) The newly renovated Cassano Health Center continues its excellent work in providing health care for those who need it most.

Today, I toured @KetteringHealth’s Cassano Health Center and held a press conference to highlight the center receiving $1.25M in federal funding. https://t.co/2TuJLQJzHZ
